import asyncio
from packages.memory.src.store import MemoryStore
from packages.memory.src.embeddings import EmbeddingService, reset_embedding_service
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv\(\)
reset_embedding_service\(\)

async def test_search\(\):
    store = MemoryStore\(\)
    await store.connect\(\)
    embed_service = EmbeddingService\(\)
    
    # Get the user with interpretation memories
    async with store.pool.acquire\(\) as conn:
        row = await conn.fetchrow\(''''''
            SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM memories 
            WHERE category = $1 LIMIT 1
        '''''', ''interpretation''\)
        user_id = str\(row[''user_id'']\)
    
    print\(f''User: {user_id[:8]}...''\)
    print\(''Waiting 25s for rate limit...''\)
    await asyncio.sleep\(25\)
    
    query = ''marriage timing and spouse''
    query_embedding = await embed_service.embed\(query\)
    print\(f''Query: ""{query}""''\)
    print\(f''Embedding: {len\(query_embedding\)}d''\)
    
    results = await store.search_memories\(
        user_id=user_id,
        query_embedding=query_embedding,
        limit=5,
        min_similarity=0.2
    \)
    
    print\(f''\\n=== Semantic Search Results \({len\(results\)}\) ===''\)
    for r in results:
        print\(f''  {r.similarity:.1%} | {r.memory.content}''\)
    
    await store.close\(\)
    print\(''\\n✅ Voyage + pgvector semantic search working!''\)

asyncio.run\(test_search\(\)\)
")
